content:
Former Apple Retail SVP Ron Johnson joins the Overtime show to discuss his new book, *Shop Different: How Retail Revealed Apple's Genius*. Ron shares stories from the early days of the Apple Store, working with Steve Jobs, the launch of the original iPhone, why he left Apple to become CEO of JCPenney, his thoughts on the current state of Apple Retail, and of course his take on the iPhone Duo.
